tools.name: browse_business_category
tools.description: Lists public directory entries in one business category, optionally narrowed to a locality/postcode/canton. Use search_swiss_directory instead for a free-text query.

category.description: The business category slug (e.g. "restaurant", "coiffeur", "sanitaer"). Valid slugs are the slug values in categories, as returned by get_directory_entry, or a top-level group slug such as "bau-handwerk".

location.description: Locality, postcode, or canton (e.g. "Baden", "5400", "ZH") to narrow the category to. Always put a place name here.

lang.description: Response language: de, fr, it, or en. Defaults to de.

tools.name: get_directory_entry
tools.description: Fetches the full public detail for one directory entry by its entry_id (public_id), including phone numbers, opening hours, and links when the entry has them. Use get_directory_entry for phone numbers and opening hours; use search_swiss_directory or browse_business_category to find an entry_id first.

entry_id.description: The entry's public_id, as returned by search_swiss_directory, browse_business_category, or reverse_phone_lookup.

lang.description: Response language: de, fr, it, or en. Defaults to de.

tools.name: reverse_phone_lookup
tools.description: Looks up the public directory entry (or entries) associated with a Swiss phone number. Accepts national ("079 123 45 67"), E.164 ("+41791234567"), or compact notation. Returns an empty result list when the number has no findable public listing.

phone_number.description: The phone number to look up, in any common Swiss notation (national, E.164, or compact).

lang.description: Response language: de, fr, it, or en. Defaults to de.

tools.name: search_swiss_directory
tools.description: Full-text search over the Swiss public phone/business directory (1820.ch). Matches ALL words in query, so a short keyword works best; put any place name in location, not query. For "business type X in place Y", browse_business_category with a category slug is an alternative. Use get_directory_entry for phone numbers and opening hours of a specific result.

query.description: One short keyword: a person's or company name, or ONE business type (e.g. "Müller", "Migros", "Coiffeur"). Every word must match, so no sentences or extra adjectives. Never put a place name here — use location instead.

location.description: Locality, postcode, or canton (e.g. "Baden", "5400", "ZH") to narrow the search. Always put a place name here, never in query.

entry_type.description: Restrict results to person, business, or all entries.

lang.description: Response language: de, fr, it, or en. Defaults to de.
